mcp.instructions: Write-only Outlook mailbox and calendar tools. create_draft creates a draft; update_draft edits fields on an existing draft. Both default to a plain-text body but accept an isHtml flag to send HTML instead (e.g. for a table). Neither can send mail - there is no send capability. create_event and update_event write calendar events. delete_event is two-step and confirmation-gated: the first call returns the event's details plus a confirmation token and deletes nothing; pass that token back on a second call to actually delete. This server has no read or search tools - obtain draft and event IDs from the Microsoft 365 connector's read/search tools, which share the same Graph ID space.
